name: Monthly budget breach
_doc: Fires if forecast end-of-month spend exceeds $650.

name: Daily spike — 2× weekly average
_doc: Fires if today's spend is 2× or more than the 7-day rolling average.

name: New service appeared in bill
_doc: Fires if a service that had no spend in the prior 14 days starts incurring cost. Catches accidental services left running.
